children.game_version: Play as a musical statues game: dance the fast line step while the music plays, and freeze completely while yelling 'Hey!' the instant it stops.

avoid: Sudden twisting or sharp stops that compromise balance.
seniors.counts: 2-measure cycles with static pause on the musical break.
seniors.seated_version: Perform seated foot-tapping to the fast pulse, lifting arms and clapping with a shout of 'Hey!' on the music stops.
seniors.standing_version: Execute gentle side-steps in a supported line, pausing in place during the musical breaks.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Moderate tempo with smaller step range to ensure stability.

learning_units.description: Execute the sudden Koftos pause and shout during a musical break.

social_formats.description: Line or circle dance that can also be performed with partners or moving back and forth.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Connected hands in line formation; during breaks, arms raise up, drop down, or clap.
movement_profile.footwork: Two-measure (sta dio) fast Syrtos steps traveling sideways, forward, or backward.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Open circle or line, moving laterally, in/out, or with partners.
movement_profile.partnering: Can be danced as a group line or adapted for couples/partners.
movement_profile.posture: Upright line-dance posture with connected arms.

signature_moves.description: Freezing in place during a sudden music break while shouting 'Hey!' and clapping or shifting arm positions.
signature_moves.name: The Cut (Koftos Stop)

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Failing to stop when the music cuts; missing the vocal accent.

music_profile.musical_form: Periodic melodic phrases punctuated by sudden cuts/silences
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Fast Syrtos pattern with sudden complete rest/break measures
music_profile.sound_description: A fast, driving Greek Syrtos melody that repeatedly stops short without warning, prompting a collective shout of 'Hey!' from the dancers during the brief silent breaks.

basic_steps: Travel laterally using a fast two-measure Syrtos step progression.
Optionally transition movement direction forward and backward or face a partner.
Upon the sudden musical cut, halt movement immediately.
Shout 'Hey!' while simultaneously raising arms, dropping arms, or clapping.
teaching.formation: Open line or circle; can also be danced in partner formation.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on maintaining the fast Syrtos footwork while staying alert for the sudden musical silences.
teaching.rhythm: Fast two-measure (sta dio) Syrtos rhythm featuring abrupt musical stops.
